rounds.text: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading at a discounted share price of ₹ 565 while a disciplined discounted cash flow model explicitly pegs intrinsic value at ₹ 733 per share, leaving a generous margin of safety of 22.9% [E40, E41]. The current market price only prices in a modest 14.4% earnings growth via a reverse DCF, which heavily undershoots the robust 18.0% base case and ignores compounding profit growth of 152% over the trailing twelve months and 88% over three years [E18, E19, E42]. Operational performance is elite, showcased by a staggering ROCE of 70.7%, an ROE of 60.0%, and a sector-crushing ROA of 32.88% compared to the sector benchmark of 10.59% [E8, E12, E13]. Furthermore, heavy capital expenditure is largely complete with capital-work-in-progress down 84.6%, directly fueling massive operational cash flows of ₹ 262 Cr and free cash flow of ₹ 231 Cr in March 2026 backed by a stellar 1.18x cash conversion ratio [E30, E31, E35]. Conceded: the stock sits 20% of the way up its 52-week range and below its moving averages, reflecting short-term sentiment drag despite exceptional fundamentals [E5, E45].
